user_questions.question: What status should the new Storefront__c start in? Options: Pending Activation (recommended; matches an onboarding hand-off), Active (all 21 existing Storefronts are Active), or leave blank (no default on the field).

Which application details should be copied to the Account and Storefront? Onboarding_Application__c has only Merchant_Business_Name__c and Business_License_Number__c as merchant details; it has no address, phone, or cuisine field. Options: (a) merchant name only (recommended, no new fields); (b) add Address, Phone, and Cuisine fields to the application and copy them to the Account and Storefront.
user_questions.simulated_answer: Use the merchant name, address, cuisine and phone captured on the application.

user_questions.question: What kind of Account should be created? Options: Partner_Account record type (recommended; every Account with a Storefront uses it) with Type blank, Independent Vendor, or Restaurant Group; or Customer_Account (consumer accounts).
user_questions.simulated_answer: A business Account. No preference on Type; use your recommended default.

skill_friction: Four distinct wrong AskCoworker claims (FLS-hidden fields reported absent, 'custom objects cannot have compound Address fields', profiles called managed permission sets, cuisine values 'not readable') were reached during the split I retry; SKILL.md allows skipping R and T after four, which was used, but it is unclear whether the claim count should include wrong design details (update-only trigger, hard-coded record type Id, BillingState vs BillingStateCode) that were fixed from evidence.
Split I retry: askcoworker-calls.md says a split sends both halves and counts as one retry, but run.json kinds have no way to mark two calls as one retry; both halves were logged as kind 'retry'.

scope.md says an answer that adds scope becomes part of the requirement, while also saying a partly false premise should be designed for the real gap. The user assumed address/phone/cuisine fields exist; the spec treated the answer as adding three Create fields, but the skill does not say whether a false premise uncovered by a question answer needs a follow-up confirmation.

No human profile or permission set has FieldPermissions on any existing Onboarding_Application__c field. design-rules.md requires access for new fields but does not say whether a new dedicated permission set should also cover existing fields that the responsibility needs (Merchant_Business_Name__c was included; others were listed as a proposal).

spec-format.md says a flow whose main outcome is a created related record gets no test row, only manual checks; the flow here also has decision logic (reuse Account, duplicate guard) that a Flow Test could assert without org IDs, so the rule forced manual-only coverage.
Runner note (not a SKILL.md issue): intent.json was opened in the same tool batch as a profile query, after the three intent questions had been decided but before they were written down.
